### Reading main MEA dataset and further processing

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Loading the datasets with MEA data and drug responses
d1<-read_csv("./data/MEA_Main_Dataset.csv") # Dataset from first version of the manuscript
d2<-read_csv("./data/MEA_Revision_Dataset.csv") # Dataset generated for the revision, containing data on three additional lines we included (SCVI507c1, SCVI209c1, S34Ec16)

# Combining the two datasets into a single complete dataset
dt_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(d1, d2)

## Levels setup
dt_full$`Cell Line` <- factor(dt_full$`Cell Line`, levels = c("WTC-11", "S34Ec16", "HDF29c7", "HDF28c44", "HDF30c3", "HDFSA6c27", "HDFSA15c14", "HDFSA14c19", "HDFSA13c5", "HDF26c1","HDF27c2", "SCVI209c1","SCVI498c1", "SCVI507c1"))

dt_full$`Variant` <- factor(dt_full$`Variant`, levels = c("WT", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", "KCNQ1-p.R190W & p.R594Q",
"KCNQ1-p.A341V", "KCNH2-p.R366X", "KCNH2-p.A561V","KCNH2-p.T983I", "KCNH2-p.R823W"))

# This sets the levels for the complete dataset, including all the concentrations and, in some cases, the conditions.
dt_full$`Dose Label` <- factor(dt_full$`Dose Label`, levels = c("Control", "Vehicle", "E4031", "3 pM","4 pM" ,"5 pM", "6 pM", "10 pM",
                                                                                        "1 nM", "2 nM", "3 nM", "7 nM", "10 nM", "20 nM", "30 nM", "67 nM", 
                                                                                        "100 nM", "300 nM", "500 nM", "1 µM", "2 µM", "3 µM", "5 µM", "10 µM",
                                                                                        "30 µM", "100 µM", "300 µM"))

dt_full$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(dt_full$`Variant Risk Level`, levels = c("Low Risk", "High Risk"))

dt_full$Disease <- factor(dt_full$Disease, levels = c("Healthy", "LQT1", "JLNS", "LQT2"))

dt_full <- dt_full %>% 
  mutate(`Mutated Gene` = case_when(
    Disease == "Healthy" ~ "WT",
    Disease == "LQT1" ~ "KCNQ1",
    Disease == "JLNS" ~ "KCNQ1",
    Disease == "LQT2" ~ "KCNH2",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Default for unmatched cases
  ))

dt_full$`Mutated Gene` <- factor(
  dt_full$`Mutated Gene`,
  levels = c("WT", "KCNQ1", "KCNH2")  # desired order
)

dt_full$FourScore <- factor(dt_full$FourScore, levels = c(3, 2, 1, 0))

# Disease lines added during the revision phase
validation_cell_lines <- c("SCVI209c1", "SCVI507c1")

# Creation of Main dataset (excluding validation cell lines)
dt <- dt_full %>%
  filter(!`Cell Line` %in% validation_cell_lines)

# Creation of Validation dataset (only validation cell lines)
dt_validation <- dt_full %>%
  filter(`Cell Line` %in% validation_cell_lines)
```

## Figure 1
### Figure 1A Cardiac events frequency overall
```{r}
# Pre-computed aggregate cardiac events summary
cardiac_events_summary <- read_csv("data/LQTS_cardiac_events_summary.csv")

dbLQT1_combined <- cardiac_events_summary %>% filter(Disease == "LQT1")
dbLQT2_combined <- cardiac_events_summary %>% filter(Disease == "LQT2")


plot <- ggplot() +
  # Normalized Histogram for LQT1
  geom_histogram(data = dbLQT1_combined, aes(x = Percentage, y = ..count../max(..count..)), 
                 fill = "#3A4966", alpha = 0.6, binwidth = 11, color = "#000000") +
  # Normalized Histogram for LQT2
  geom_histogram(data = dbLQT2_combined, aes(x = Percentage, y = ..count../max(..count..)), 
                 fill = "#F28E2B", alpha = 0.6, binwidth = 11, color = "#000000") +
  # Density plot for LQT1
  geom_density(data = dbLQT1_combined, aes(x = Percentage, y = ..scaled..), 
               fill = NA, color = "#3A4966", size = 1, bw = 7) +
  # Density plot for LQT2
  geom_density(data = dbLQT2_combined, aes(x = Percentage, y = ..scaled..), 
               fill = NA, color = "#F28E2B", size = 1, bw = 7) +
  # Threshold line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 25, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 45, y = 0.8, label = "25% Threshold", color = "black", vjust = -1.5, size = 10) +
  # Labels and titles
  labs(
    x = "Cardiac events frequency (%)", 
    y = "Normalized count / density", 
    title = "Distribution of cardiac events frequency per variant"
  ) +
  # Customize theme
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_text(size = 24),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=24),
        axis.title=element_text(size=30),
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 20),
        plot.background = element_rect(color = "white"),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )+
  # Adjust legend colors and labels
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Dataset", values = c("#3A4966", "#F28E2B")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Condition", labels = c("LQT1", "LQT2")))

ggsave("./figures/Figure1A_Cardiac_events_distribution.pdf", plot, width = 25, height = 20 , units = "cm")
```

## Figure 2
### Figure 2B,C QTc and Schwartz Score Statistics

```{r}
# Filter the data for relevant variants
db_filtered <- dbLQTm %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c("KCNQ1-p.A341V", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", "KCNH2-p.A561V", "KCNH2-p.R366X"))

# Calculate N for each variant
variant_counts <- db_filtered %>%
   filter(!is.na(`Basal QTc (ms)`)) %>%
  group_by(Variant) %>%
  summarise(N = n())
print(variant_counts)

variant_counts <- db_filtered %>%
   filter(!is.na(`Schwartz Score`)) %>%
  group_by(Variant) %>%
  summarise(N = n())
print(variant_counts)


dunn_QTc <- dunnTest(`Basal QTc (ms)` ~ Variant, data = db_filtered, method = "bh")


dunn_QTc <- dunn_QTc$res %>%
  select(Comparison, Z, P.adj) %>%
  mutate(Significance = case_when(
    P.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    P.adj <= 0.01 ~ "**",
    P.adj <= 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

print(dunn_QTc)

# Perform Dunn's test for `Schwartz Score`
dunn_SS <- dunnTest(`Schwartz Score` ~ Variant, data = db_filtered, method = "bh")

dunn_SS<- dunn_SS$res %>%
  select(Comparison, Z, P.adj) %>%
  mutate(Significance = case_when(
    P.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    P.adj <= 0.01 ~ "**",
    P.adj <= 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))
print(dunn_SS)

```

### Table S5 QTc and Schwartz Score table

```{r}
# Step 1: Calculate summary statistics for each Variant
summary <- dbLQTm %>%
  group_by(`Variant`) %>%  
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    mean_QT = round(mean(`Basal QTc (ms)`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd_QT = round(sd(`Basal QTc (ms)`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_SS = round(mean(`Schwartz Score`, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd_SS = round(sd(`Schwartz Score`, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `QTc (ms)` = paste0(mean_QT, " ± ", sd_QT),
    `Schwartz Score` = paste0(mean_SS, " ± ", sd_SS)
  )


summary <- summary %>%  
    dplyr::select(Variant, N, 
                `QTc (ms)`,
                 `Schwartz Score`)

print(summary)

```

### Figure 2C Baseline cFPD for LQT1-JLNS family trio
```{r}
dtc <- dt %>% 
  filter(`Dose Label` == 'Control') %>% 
  filter(`Cell Line` %in% c("WTC-11", "HDF29c7", "HDF28c44", "HDF30c3")) %>% 
  mutate(`Cell Line` = ifelse(`Cell Line` == "WTC-11", "WT1",
                       ifelse(`Cell Line` == "HDF28c44", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", 
                       ifelse(`Cell Line` == "HDF29c7", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", 
                       ifelse(`Cell Line` == "HDF30c3", "KCNQ1-p.R190W &\n p.R594Q", `Cell Line`)))))

dtc$`Cell Line` <- factor(dtc$`Cell Line`,
                                levels = c("WT1", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", "KCNQ1-p.R190W &\n p.R594Q"))

plot <- dtc %>% 
  ggplot(aes(`Cell Line`, cFPD, fill = `Cell Line`)) +
  geom_dotplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    binaxis = 'y',
    stackdir = 'center',
    dotsize = 10, 
    alpha = 0.2,
    binwidth = 2, 
    stroke = 0.3 
  ) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8))+
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", size = 7, colour = "black", pch = 21, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8))+
  labs(x = "Genetic variant", y = "cFPD (ms)") +
  ggtitle("Corrected Field Potential Duration") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 750)) +
  #theme_base(base_size = 12) +    
  theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 26),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 24),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.background = element_rect(color = "white")) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Pastel2")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel2")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10)) +
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = `Cell Line`), 
                     label = "p.signif",
                     ref.group = "WT1", 
                     symnum.args = list(
                       cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                       symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "")),  # Leave empty for "ns" 
                     label.y = 700,
                     size = 6)

 
ggsave("./figures/Figure2C_trio_MEA_baseline_cFPD.pdf", plot, width = 17, height = 17, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
df_step <- read_csv("./data/VClamp_Step.csv") 
df_step <- 
  df_step %>% 
   mutate(Group = ifelse(Group == "WT", "WT1",
                       ifelse(Group == "LQT1_R594Q", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", 
                       ifelse(Group == "LQT1_R190W", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", 
                       ifelse(Group == "Compound JLNS", "KCNQ1-p.R190W &\n p.R594Q", Group)))))

df_step$Group <- factor(df_step$Group,
                        levels=c("WT1", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", "KCNQ1-p.R190W &\n p.R594Q"))

df_tail <- read_csv("./data/VClamp_Tail.csv")
df_tail <- 
  df_tail %>% 
     mutate(Group = ifelse(Group == "WT", "WT1",
                       ifelse(Group == "LQT1_R594Q", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", 
                       ifelse(Group == "LQT1_R190W", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", 
                       ifelse(Group == "Compound JLNS", "KCNQ1-p.R190W &\n p.R594Q", Group)))))


df_tail$Group <- factor(df_tail$Group,
                        levels=c("WT1", "KCNQ1-p.R190W", "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", "KCNQ1-p.R190W &\n p.R594Q"))

# Plots
p <- 
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "white", color = NA))

tail_combined_figure <- 
  df_tail %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Voltage, y = `Current Density`, colour = Group, fill = Group))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 3)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3)+
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "line")+
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar", width = 1)+
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", size = 4, pch = 21, colour = "black")+
  labs(x = "Voltage (mV)", y = "Current Density (pA/pF)")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Pastel2")+
  scale_colour_brewer(palette="Pastel2")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        axis.title=element_text(size=26),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")+
  ggtitle("Tail Current") +
  annotate("text", label = "*", size = 8, x = 60, xend = 60, y = 1.95, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "*", size = 8, x = 50, xend = 50, y = 1.9, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "*", size = 8, x = 40, xend = 40, y = 1.85, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "*", size = 8, x = 30, xend = 30, y = 1.7, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "*", size = 8, x = 20, xend = 20, y = 1.45, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "*", size = 8, x = 10, xend = 10, y = 1.35, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "*", size = 8, x = 0, xend = 0, y = 1.05, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "#", size = 4, x = -10, xend = -10, y = 0.85, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "#", size = 4, x = -20, xend = -20, y = 0.7, yend = 1.95)+
  annotate("text", label = "#", size = 4, x = -30, xend = -30, y = 0.55, yend = 1.95)

# * means p<0.05 WT1 vs rest
# # means p<0.05 WT1 vs JLNS
  
anova_test <- aov(`Current Density` ~ Voltage * Group, data = df_tail)
summary(anova_test)

posthoc_tail <- df_tail %>%
  group_by(Voltage) %>%
  pairwise_t_test(
    `Current Density` ~ Group,
    p.adjust.method = "bonferroni",
    ref.group = "WT1"  # WT is the reference group
  )
```

### Table 2 Baseline MEA electrophysiology for each variant
```{r}
dtc<- dt_full %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` == 'Control') 

summary <- dtc %>%
  group_by(Variant) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),  # Count total number of observations per Variant
    `FPD, ms` = paste(round(mean(FPD, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " ± ", round(sd(FPD, na.rm = TRUE), 1)),
    `cFPD, ms` = paste(round(mean(cFPD, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " ± ", round(sd(cFPD, na.rm = TRUE), 1)),
    `RR, s` = paste(round(mean(RR, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " ± ", round(sd(RR, na.rm = TRUE), 2))
  )

#View(summary)
#Dunn's Test for FPD, cFPD, and RR
dunn_test_result_FPD <- dunnTest(FPD ~ Variant, data = dtc, method = "bh")
dunn_test_pvalues_FPD <- dunn_test_result_FPD$res %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      P.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ ""
    )
  )
#View(dunn_test_pvalues_FPD )

dunn_test_result_cFPD <- dunnTest(cFPD ~ Variant, data = dtc, method = "bh")
dunn_test_pvalues_cFPD <- dunn_test_result_cFPD$res%>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      P.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ ""
    )
  )
#View(dunn_test_pvalues_cFPD )

dunn_test_result_RR <- dunnTest(RR ~ Variant, data = dtc, method = "bh")
dunn_test_pvalues_RR <- dunn_test_result_RR$res%>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      P.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ ""
    )
  )
```

### Figure 3E Baseline beating patterns
```{r}
Palette2 <- c( "#EBE9E9", "#FF9F1C", "#d62828","#003049")

# Subset data to control condition only
dtc <- dt %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` == 'Control')

# Calculate Fisher's Exact Test for the plot
contingency_table <- table(dtc$`Variant Risk Level`, dtc$FourScore)
fisher_statistics <- apply(contingency_table, 1, function(row) fisher.test(rbind(contingency_table[1, ], row))$p.value)
print(fisher_statistics)

# Build contingency table as a data frame
ct_df <- 
  as.data.frame(contingency_table) %>%
  rename(
    VariantRisk = Var1,
    FourScore = Var2,
    Freq = Freq
  )

# Calculate percentages of irregular beating wells
percent_df <- ct_df %>%
  filter(FourScore %in% c("2", "3")) %>%   # include regular + irregular
  group_by(VariantRisk) %>%
  summarise(
    irregular = sum(Freq[FourScore == "2"]),
    total = sum(Freq),
    percent = irregular / total * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(round(percent, 1), "%")
  )

#View(percent_df)

# Create the plot
plot <- dtc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Variant Risk Level`, fill = FourScore)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = after_stat(count)), position = "fill", colour = "black", width = 0.75) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = Palette2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Palette2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25), limits = c(0, 1.1)) +
  labs(y = "Irregularly beating wells (%)", color = "FourScore") +
  ggtitle("Beating pattern") +
  #theme_base(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 3/2,
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(color = "white"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = "High Risk", y = 1.1, label = "***", vjust = 1, size = 8, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = percent_df, aes(x = VariantRisk, y = irregular / total / 2, label = label),
  size = 8,
  color = "black",
  inherit.aes = FALSE
)

# Save the plot
ggsave("./figures/Figure3E_baseline_beating_patterns.pdf", plot, width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
combined_plots_list <- lapply(drugs1, function(drug) {
  # Low Risk Plot
  drug_plot1 <- plot1 %+% filter(common_filter_LR, Drug == drug) 
  drug_plot1 <- drug_plot1 + ggtitle("Low Risk") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "#0072B2"))
  
  # High Risk Plot
  drug_plot2 <- plot2 %+% filter(common_filter_HR, Drug == drug) + 
    ggtitle("High Risk") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "#E44E58"))
  
  # Other Plots
  drug_plot3 <- plot3 %+% filter(common_filter, Drug == drug)
  drug_plot4 <- plot4 %+% filter(common_filter, Drug == drug)
  drug_plot5 <- plot5 %+% filter(common_filter, Drug == drug)
  
  # Combine Plots
  drug_combined_plot <- (drug_plot1 / drug_plot2 / drug_plot3 / drug_plot4 / drug_plot5) + 
    plot_layout() &
    theme(plot.background = element_blank())
  
  # Add drug name as title on top of combined plot
  drug_combined_plot_with_text <- drug_combined_plot + 
    plot_annotation(title = drug, 
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1)))
  
  return(drug_combined_plot_with_text)
})

# Arrange the plots in a grid
grid_plot <- plot_grid(plotlist = combined_plots_list, 
                       ncol = length(combined_plots_list),
```

```{r}
### Paired statistics Vehicle vs each dose for dose response of HMR1556
dt_filtered <- dt %>%
  rename(Dose = `Dose Label`) %>%
  filter(
    Drug == "HMR1556",
    Dose != "Control"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = paste(`Variant Risk Level`, `Well Label`, Plate, Date, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  select(SampleID, `Variant Risk Level`, Dose, norm_cFPD)

# Convert to wide format: one row per SampleID, one column per Dose
dt_wide <- dt_filtered %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Dose,
    values_from = norm_cFPD
  )

dose_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dt_wide), c("SampleID", "Variant Risk Level", "Vehicle"))

paired_results_HMR1556 <- lapply(dose_cols, function(dose) {
  dt_wide %>%
    group_by(`Variant Risk Level`) %>%
    summarise(
      wt = list(wilcox.test(Vehicle, .data[[dose]], paired = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dose = dose,
      p.value = sapply(wt, function(x) x$p.value)
    ) %>%
    select(`Variant Risk Level`, Dose, p.value)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  # Adjust p-values across all comparisons
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  mutate(signif = case_when(
    p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
    p.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE          ~ ""
  ))

#View(paired_results_HMR1556)
```

### Figures 4-5 Fisher test statistics

```{r}
# Summarise counts
summary_table <- dt %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Control") %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`, `FourScore`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%  #FourScore counts calculation
  mutate(FourScore = factor(FourScore, levels = 0:3)) %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  complete(`FourScore`, fill = list(count = 0)) %>% #Complete missing FourScore values
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(percent = ifelse(total_count > 0, count / total_count * 100, 0)) %>% #calculate the percentages
  ungroup()

#Create a contingency table and perform Fisher's Exact tests
fisher_test_results <- summary_table  %>%
  group_by( Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    tbl <- xtabs(count ~ `Variant Risk Level` + FourScore, data = .)
    test_result <- fisher.test(tbl)  # Perform Fisher's Exact Test
    tibble(p_value = test_result$p.value)  # Extract p-value and return as a tibble
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#Join Fisher test results (p-values) to the summary table
summary_table_with_p <- summary_table %>%
  left_join(fisher_test_results, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", round(p_value, 3))  # Format p-values
  )

print(summary_table_with_p)
```

### Table S7 Statistics for drug response
```{r}
#Calculate the summary statistics for normalized variables
summary <- dt %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control') %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Vehicle') %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),  # Count total observations per group
    `norm_FPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_FPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_FPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_cFPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_RR` = paste(round(mean(norm_RR, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_RR, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_PtPA` = paste(round(mean(norm_PtPA, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_PtPA, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1))
  )

#Calculate p-values for each Drug and Dose Label between High Risk and Low Risk groups
p_values <- dt %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control') %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Vehicle') %>%
  group_by(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    # Capture p-values for each test conditionally
    p_val_norm_FPD <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
      wilcox.test(norm_FPD ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    p_val_norm_cFPD <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
      wilcox.test(norm_cFPD ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    p_val_norm_RR <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
      wilcox.test(norm_RR ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    p_val_norm_PtPA <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
      wilcox.test(norm_PtPA ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    
    # Return results as a data frame to keep each p-value in its group
    tibble(
      Drug = first(.$Drug),
      `Dose Label` = first(.$`Dose Label`),
      p_value_norm_FPD = p_val_norm_FPD,
      p_value_norm_cFPD = p_val_norm_cFPD,
      p_value_norm_RR = p_val_norm_RR,
      p_value_norm_PtPA = p_val_norm_PtPA
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#Join and format p-values
summary <- summary %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
    `norm_FPD` = paste(
      `norm_FPD`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_FPD),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = ""),
    
    `norm_cFPD` = paste(
      `norm_cFPD`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_cFPD),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = ""),
    
    `norm_RR` = paste(
      `norm_RR`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_RR),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = ""),
    
    `norm_PtPA` = paste(
      `norm_PtPA`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_PtPA),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`, N, 
                `norm_FPD`,
                `norm_cFPD`,
                `norm_RR`,
                `norm_PtPA`)

#print(summary)
#View(summary)
```

```{r}
      TRUE             ~ paste0("p = ", formatC(p.value, digits = 2, format = "f"))
```

```{r}
  # High Risk Plot

    theme(plot.background = element_blank())

})
```

### Table S8 Statistics for KCNQ1 A341V drug response (Figure 6A)
```{r}
A341V_variant_dt <- dt %>%
  filter(Variant == "KCNQ1-p.A341V")

summary <- A341V_variant_dt %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control') %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Vehicle') %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c( "Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol",  "HMR1556 (after E4031)", "Nifedipine")) %>%
  group_by(`Cell Line`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),  # Count total observations per group
    `norm_cFPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
  )

#Calculate p-values for each Drug and Dose Label between High Risk and Low Risk groups
p_values <- A341V_variant_dt %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control') %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Vehicle') %>%
  group_by(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    # Capture p-values for each test conditionally
    p_val_norm_cFPD <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Cell Line`) > 1,
      kruskal.test(norm_cFPD ~ `Cell Line`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    
    # Return results as a data frame to keep each p-value in its group
    tibble(
      Drug = first(.$Drug),
      `Dose Label` = first(.$`Dose Label`),
      p_value_norm_cFPD = p_val_norm_cFPD,

    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#Join and format p-values
summary <- summary %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
      `norm_cFPD` = paste(
      `norm_cFPD`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_cFPD),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = ""),
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Cell Line`, Drug, `Dose Label`, N, 
                `norm_cFPD`)

summary <- summary %>%
  mutate(
    `Cell Line` = recode(
      `Cell Line`,
      "HDFSA13c5" = "KCNQ1-p.A341V, NOS1AP homo (SA13.5 line)",
      "HDFSA14c19" = "KCNQ1-p.A341V, NOS1AP hetero (SA14.19 line)",
      "HDFSA15c14" = "KCNQ1-p.A341V (SA15.14 line)",
      "HDFSA6c27" = "KCNQ1-p.A341V (SA6.27 line)"
    )
  )

print(summary)
```

### Table S9 Statistics for KCNQ1 drug response (Figure 6B)
```{r}
#Calculate the summary statistics for normalized variables
summary <- dt_full %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")) %>%
  filter(`Disease` == "LQT1" | `Disease` == "JLNS")  %>% 
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control') %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Vehicle') %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),  # Count total observations per group
    `norm_FPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_FPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_FPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_cFPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_RR` = paste(round(mean(norm_RR, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_RR, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_PtPA` = paste(round(mean(norm_PtPA, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_PtPA, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1))
  )

#Calculate p-values for each Drug and Dose Label between High Risk and Low Risk groups
p_values <- dt_full %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")) %>%
  filter(`Disease` == "LQT1" | `Disease` == "JLNS")  %>% 
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control') %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Vehicle') %>%
  group_by(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    # Capture p-values for each test conditionally
    p_val_norm_FPD <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
                             wilcox.test(norm_FPD ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    p_val_norm_cFPD <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
                              wilcox.test(norm_cFPD ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    p_val_norm_RR <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
                            wilcox.test(norm_RR ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    p_val_norm_PtPA <- ifelse(n_distinct(.$`Variant Risk Level`) > 1,
                              wilcox.test(norm_PtPA ~ `Variant Risk Level`, data = .)$p.value, NA)
    
    # Return results as a data frame to keep each p-value in its group
    tibble(
      Drug = first(.$Drug),
      `Dose Label` = first(.$`Dose Label`),
      p_value_norm_FPD = p_val_norm_FPD,
      p_value_norm_cFPD = p_val_norm_cFPD,
      p_value_norm_RR = p_val_norm_RR,
      p_value_norm_PtPA = p_val_norm_PtPA
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#Join and format p-values
summary <- summary %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
    `norm_FPD` = paste(
      `norm_FPD`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_FPD),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = ""),
    
    `norm_cFPD` = paste(
      `norm_cFPD`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_cFPD),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = ""),
    
    `norm_RR` = paste(
      `norm_RR`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_RR),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = ""),
    
    `norm_PtPA` = paste(
      `norm_PtPA`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_PtPA),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA) <= 0.001, 
                    ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA), 2)))), 
             ""), 
      sep = "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`, N, 
                `norm_FPD`,
                `norm_cFPD`,
                `norm_RR`,
                `norm_PtPA`)

# View the final summary table
print(summary)
```

```{r}
summary_table <- dt_full %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Control") %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")) %>%
  filter(`Disease` == "LQT1" | `Disease` == "JLNS")  %>% 
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`, `FourScore`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(FourScore = factor(FourScore, levels = 0:3)) %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  complete(`FourScore`, fill = list(count = 0)) %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(percent = ifelse(total_count > 0, count / total_count * 100, 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create a contingency table and perform Fisher's Exact tests
fisher_test_results <- summary_table  %>%
  group_by( Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    tbl <- xtabs(count ~ `Variant Risk Level` + FourScore, data = .)
    test_result <- fisher.test(tbl)  # Perform Fisher's Exact Test
    tibble(p_value = test_result$p.value)  # Extract p-value and return as a tibble
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join Fisher test results (p-values) to the summary table
summary_table_with_p <- summary_table %>%
  left_join(fisher_test_results, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", round(p_value, 3))  # Format p-values
  )

print(summary_table_with_p)

# KCNH2
summary_table <- dt_full %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Control") %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")) %>%
  filter(`Disease` == "LQT2")  %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`, `FourScore`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(FourScore = factor(FourScore, levels = 0:3)) %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  complete(`FourScore`, fill = list(count = 0)) %>%
  group_by(`Variant Risk Level`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(percent = ifelse(total_count > 0, count / total_count * 100, 0)) %>%

# Create a contingency table and perform Fisher's Exact tests
```

### Figure 7C Variant Risk level classification: All drugs all datapoints The Aim is to classify the Variant Risk Level (High Risk, Low Risk) based on the MEA parameters. dt

```{r, Variant Risk Classification}
# This is done on the original dataset with two WT lines
combined_output_files <- dt
combined_output_files$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(combined_output_files$`Variant Risk Level`, levels = c( "High Risk", "Low Risk")) #inverse for proper classification

combined_output_files_ml_all <- 
  combined_output_files %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(
               "T Detection Timestamp [µs]",
               "Dose [pM]",
               "Mean RR Interval [µs]",
               "Mean Peak-to-Peak Amplitude [pV]",
               "Mean Slope [V/s]",
               "RR Interval CV",
               "Drug",
               "Variant Risk Level",
               "FourScore",
               "norm_FPD",
               "norm_RR",
               "norm_PtPA"
               )

combined_output_files_ml <-
  combined_output_files_ml_all

ml_risk <- combined_output_files_ml

ml_risk$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(ml_risk$`Variant Risk Level`)
ml_risk <- na.omit(ml_risk)

#Splitting the data
set.seed(86)
data_split <- initial_split(ml_risk,
                            prop = .7,
                            strata = Drug) #Split 70:30

ml_risk_train <- training(data_split)
ml_risk_validate <- testing(data_split)

risk_rec <- 
  recipe(`Variant Risk Level` ~ ., data = ml_risk_train) %>% 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>% # Convert all nominal variables to dummy variables
  step_zv(all_predictors()) #removes zero variance (zv) columns from computations but not dataset

rf_spec <- 
  rand_forest(
    mtry = tune(), 
    trees = tune(), 
    min_n = tune()
    ) %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") %>% 
  set_mode("classification")

# Create the workflow
risk_wflow <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_model(rf_spec) %>% 
  add_recipe(risk_rec)

# Define the parameter grid for tuning
# mtry: number of predictors randomly sampled at each split
# trees: number of trees in the forest
# min_n: minimum number of data points in a node
rf_grid <- 
  parameters(
    mtry(range = c(1, ncol(ml_risk_train) - 1)), #USE THESE FOR FINAL
    trees(range = c(500, 1500)),                 #USE THESE FOR FINAL
    min_n(range = c(2, 10))                      #USE THESE FOR FINAL
    # mtry(range = c(2, 5)),                                                          #DEBUG ONLY
    # trees(range = c(500, 500)),  # fix trees                                        #DEBUG ONLY
    # min_n(range = c(5, 5))                                                          #DEBUG ONLY
  ) %>%
  grid_regular(levels = 3) # Explore 3 levels for each parameter

# Set up cross-validation folds for tuning
cv_data_tune_risk <- vfold_cv(ml_risk_train, v = 10, strata = `Variant Risk Level`)

# Perform hyperparameter tuning
tune_results_risk <- 
  risk_wflow %>% 
  tune_grid(
    resamples = cv_data_tune_risk,
    grid = rf_grid,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy, f_meas),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  )

# Select the best model based on ROC AUC (selected because more robust for potentially imbalanced classes)
best_rf_params_risk <- 
  tune_results_risk %>% 
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc") # this identifies the best combination of mtry, trees and min_n for tuning.

# Finalize the workflow with the best parameters
final_wflow <- 
  risk_wflow %>% 
  finalize_workflow(best_rf_params_risk)

# Fit the finalized workflow to the training data
final_fit <- 
  final_wflow %>% 
  fit(data = ml_risk_train)

# Save the final, trained workflow object to a file
saveRDS(final_fit, file = "models/final_risk_classification_model.rds")

## Predict the validation dataset using the final model
predictions <- final_fit %>% 
  predict(ml_risk_validate)

risk_aug <- 
  parsnip::augment(final_fit, ml_risk_validate)

# Collect metrics from the tuning results for overall performance
resample_metrics <- collect_metrics(tune_results_risk, summarize = TRUE) # These are the combinations of parameters from the grid
best_model_metrics_risk <- 
  collect_metrics(tune_results_risk) %>%
  inner_join(best_rf_params_risk, by = c("mtry", "trees", "min_n")) # Selecting the combination that gives higher roc_auc, but also keeping accuracy

# Creating the ROC curve
ROC_risk_all_lines <- 
  risk_aug %>% 
  roc_curve(truth = `Variant Risk Level`, `.pred_High Risk`) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity))+
           geom_abline(lty = 2, col = "gray80", size = 1) + 
           geom_path(show.legend = F, alpha = .8, size = 2, col = "#479B55") + 
           coord_equal()+
  annotate("text", label = paste("Accuracy: ", round(best_model_metrics_risk %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(mean), 2)), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -3, hjust = 1.1, size = 12)+
  annotate("text", label = paste("AUC: ", round(best_model_metrics_risk %>% filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>% pull(mean), 2)), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -1, hjust = 1.1, size = 12)+
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30, family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 30),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)) 

ggsave("./figures/Figure7C_ROC_risk_main_dataset.pdf", ROC_risk_all_lines, width = 22, height = 20, units = "cm")


```

### Figure 7J: Variant Risk Classification - all variants WITHOUT ONE - Full dataset - Uses optimized parameters from the previous chunk. 

The aim is to calculate accuracy of each variant prediction - leave one group out approach. This simulates multiple validation cohorts.

```{r, Variant Risk Classification - for each variant}
combined_output_files <- dt_full 

combined_output_files$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(combined_output_files$`Variant Risk Level`, levels = c( "High Risk", "Low Risk")) #inverse for proper classification

file_to_save <- data.frame(Metrix = c('Variant','Accuracy', 'Kappa', 'AccuracyLower', 'AccuracyUpper', 
               'AccuracyNull', 'AccuracyPValue', 'McnemarPValue', 
               'Sensitivity', 'Specificity', 'Pos Pred Value',
               'Neg Pred Value', 'Precision', 'Recall', 'F1',
               'Prevalence', 'Detection Rate', 'Detection Prevalence',
               'Balanced Accuracy'))

variants_to_exclude <- c("WT", 
                         "KCNQ1-p.R190W", 
                         "KCNQ1-p.R594Q", 
                         "KCNQ1-p.R190W & p.R594Q", 
                         "KCNQ1-p.A341V", 
                         "KCNH2-p.R366X", 
                         "KCNH2-p.A561V", 
                         "KCNH2-p.T983I", 
                         "KCNH2-p.R823W")

for (variant in variants_to_exclude) {
  set.seed(86)
  combined_output_files_ml_all <- 
  combined_output_files %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(Variant != variant) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
               "T Detection Timestamp [µs]",
               "Dose [pM]",
               "Mean RR Interval [µs]",
               "Mean Peak-to-Peak Amplitude [pV]",
               "Mean Slope [V/s]",
               "RR Interval CV",
               "Drug",
               "Variant Risk Level",
               "FourScore",
               "norm_FPD",
               "norm_RR",
               "norm_PtPA"
               ) 

ml_risk <- combined_output_files_ml_all

ml_risk$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(ml_risk$`Variant Risk Level`)
ml_risk <- na.omit(ml_risk)

## Splitting the data
data_split <- initial_split(ml_risk,
                            prop = .7,
                            strata = Drug) #Split 70:30

ml_risk_train <- training(data_split)
ml_risk_validate <- testing(data_split)

risk_rec <-
  recipe(`Variant Risk Level` ~ ., data = ml_risk_train) %>%
      #step_downsample(`Variant Risk Level`) %>% # This command balances the groups. Package themis.
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE)  # Convert all nominal variables to dummy variables

# Using now the optimized `best_rf_params_risk` from the Risk model since I have tune the risk model before.

rf_mod <-
  rand_forest(
    mtry = best_rf_params_risk$mtry,
    trees = best_rf_params_risk$trees,
    min_n = best_rf_params_risk$min_n
  ) %>%
  set_engine("ranger") %>%
  set_mode("classification")


risk_wflow <-
  workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_mod) %>%
  add_recipe(risk_rec)

## CV
cv_data <- vfold_cv(ml_risk, v = 10, strata = `Variant Risk Level`)
resample <- rf_mod %>%
  fit_resamples(`Variant Risk Level`~., cv_data)

risk_fit <-
  risk_wflow %>%
  fit(data = ml_risk_train)

## Predict the validation dataset
predictions <- risk_fit %>%
  predict(ml_risk_validate)

risk_aug <-
  parsnip::augment(risk_fit, ml_risk_validate)

print(collect_metrics(resample, summarize = T))

# Creating the ROC curve in cycle
ROC_risk_wo_variant <- 
  risk_aug %>% 
  roc_curve(truth = `Variant Risk Level`, `.pred_High Risk`) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity))+
           geom_abline(lty = 2, col = "gray80", size = 1) + 
           geom_path(show.legend = F, alpha = .8, size = 2, col = "#479B55") + 
           coord_equal()+
  #ggtitle("Variant Risk Classification Model")+
  annotate("text", label = print(paste("Accuracy: ", round(collect_metrics(resample)[[3]][1],2))), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -3, hjust = 1.1, size = 20)+
  annotate("text", label = print(paste("AUC: ", round(collect_metrics(resample)[[3]][3],2))), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -1, hjust = 1.1, size = 20)+
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 50),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 40),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)) 
    
 ggsave(filename = paste0("./figures/Figure7I_ROC_wo_", variant, ".pdf"),
         plot = ROC_risk_wo_variant, width = 24, height = 20, units = "cm")

# Create a dataset with only the excluded variant for testing
ml_risk_test_excluded <-  combined_output_files %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(Variant == variant) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
               "T Detection Timestamp [µs]",
               "Dose [pM]",
               "Mean RR Interval [µs]",
               "Mean Peak-to-Peak Amplitude [pV]",
               "Mean Slope [V/s]",
               "RR Interval CV",
               "Drug",
               "Variant Risk Level",

               "norm_FPD",

               ) 
ml_risk_test_excluded <- na.omit(ml_risk_test_excluded)
 
# Predict the excluded variant
predictions_excluded <-   risk_fit %>%
  predict(ml_risk_test_excluded)
  
  risk_fit %>%
  predict(ml_risk_test_excluded)

####################


# Extracting actual and predicted values
actual_values <- ml_risk_test_excluded$`Variant Risk Level`
actual_values <- factor(actual_values, levels = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))
predicted_values <- pull(predictions_excluded, .pred_class)
predicted_values <- factor(predicted_values, levels = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))


# Create a confusion matrix

file_to_save1 <- data.frame(Metrix = names(conf_matrix$overall), Values = as.numeric(conf_matrix$overall))
file_to_save2 <- data.frame(Metrix = names(conf_matrix$byClass), Values = as.numeric(conf_matrix$byClass))
var <- data.frame(Metrix = 'Variant', Values = as.character(variant))
file_to_save3 <- rbind(var, file_to_save1, file_to_save2)
file_to_save <- left_join(file_to_save, file_to_save3, by = "Metrix")

}

colnames(file_to_save) <- file_to_save[1, ]
```

###TESTSupplemental Table LOO Line-by-Line prediction Blinded Variant
```{r}

# Ensure dt_full and best_rf_params_risk are defined before running this
combined_output_files <- dt_full

# Inverse factor levels so "High Risk" is the positive class
combined_output_files$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(combined_output_files$`Variant Risk Level`, 
                                                     levels = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))

# Get list of unique Cell Lines to iterate over
# (Excluding "Control" dose label if that exists in 'Cell Line' column, otherwise take all unique lines)
lines_to_test <- unique(combined_output_files$`Cell Line`)

# Initialize an empty list to store results
results_list <- list()

for (target_line in lines_to_test) {
  
  # 1. Identify the Variant associated with this specific cell line
  # We use this to ensure NO data from this variant (even from other lines) enters training
  target_variant <- unique(combined_output_files$Variant[combined_output_files$`Cell Line` == target_line])
  
  # Safety check for cleaner logs
  if(length(target_variant) > 1) target_variant <- target_variant[1]
  
  print(paste("Testing Cell Line:", target_line, "| Excluding Variant group:", target_variant, "from training."))
  
  # 2. Define Training Data 
  # CRITICAL STEP: Remove ALL rows where Variant == target_variant
  ml_risk_train_full <- combined_output_files %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    filter(Variant != target_variant) %>% 
    dplyr::select(
      "T Detection Timestamp [µs]", "Dose [pM]", "Mean RR Interval [µs]",
      "Mean Peak-to-Peak Amplitude [pV]", "Mean Slope [V/s]",
      "RR Interval CV", "Drug", "Variant Risk Level", "FourScore", 
       "norm_FPD", "norm_RR", "norm_PtPA") %>%
    na.omit()
  
  ml_risk_train_full$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(ml_risk_train_full$`Variant Risk Level`, 
                                                    levels = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))
  
  # 3. Define Test Data 
  # CRITICAL STEP: Test ONLY on the specific target_line
  ml_risk_test_excluded <- combined_output_files %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    filter(`Cell Line` == target_line) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
      "T Detection Timestamp [µs]", "Dose [pM]", "Mean RR Interval [µs]",
      "Mean Peak-to-Peak Amplitude [pV]", "Mean Slope [V/s]",
      "RR Interval CV", "Drug", "Variant Risk Level", "FourScore", 
       "norm_FPD", "norm_RR", "norm_PtPA") %>%
    na.omit()
  
  ml_risk_test_excluded$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(ml_risk_test_excluded$`Variant Risk Level`, 
                                                       levels = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))
  
  # Check if test set is empty to prevent crashes
  if(nrow(ml_risk_test_excluded) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for line:", target_line, "- Skipping"))
    next
  }
  
  # 4. Model Workflow
  risk_rec <- recipe(`Variant Risk Level` ~ ., data = ml_risk_train_full) %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) 
  
  rf_mod <- rand_forest(
    mtry = best_rf_params_risk$mtry,
    trees = best_rf_params_risk$trees,
    min_n = best_rf_params_risk$min_n
  ) %>%
    set_engine("ranger") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  risk_wflow <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(rf_mod) %>%
    add_recipe(risk_rec)
  
  # Fit the model
  risk_fit <- risk_wflow %>% fit(data = ml_risk_train_full)
  
  # 5. Predict on the Specific Cell Line
  predictions_excluded <- risk_fit %>% predict(ml_risk_test_excluded)
  
  # 6. Metrics
  actual_values <- ml_risk_test_excluded$`Variant Risk Level`
  predicted_values <- predictions_excluded$.pred_class
  
  # Create Confusion Matrix
  # Use tryCatch to handle cases where a specific class might be missing in a small test set
  tryCatch({
    conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(data = predicted_values, 
                                   reference = actual_values, 
                                   mode = "everything",
                                   positive = "High Risk")
    
    # Extract Metrics
    metrics_df <- data.frame(
      Metrix = c(names(conf_matrix$overall), names(conf_matrix$byClass)),
      Values = c(as.numeric(conf_matrix$overall), as.numeric(conf_matrix$byClass))
    )
    
    # Rename the 'Values' column to the Cell Line Name
    colnames(metrics_df)[2] <- target_line
    
    # Store in list
    results_list[[target_line]] <- metrics_df
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error calculating confusion matrix for:", target_line, "-", e$message))
  })
}

# 7. Combine all results into one dataframe
final_accuracy_table <- Reduce(function(x, y) left_join(x, y, by = "Metrix"), results_list)

print(final_accuracy_table)

# Save
write.csv(final_accuracy_table, file = "./figures/accuracy_per_line_blinded_variant.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
}
```

###FigureS22 WT vs KCNQ1/KCNH2 Stats
```{r}

# --- 1. Define Helper Function for P-value Formatting ---
format_p <- function(p_val) {
  ifelse(!is.na(p_val),
         ifelse(as.numeric(p_val) <= 0.001, ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                ifelse(as.numeric(p_val) < 0.01, 
                       paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_val), 3)), 
                       paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_val), 2)))), 
         "")
}

# --- 2. Processing Loop for Each Gene ---
genes_to_analyze <- c("KCNQ1", "KCNH2")
drugs_of_interest <- c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")

results_list <- list()

for (gene in genes_to_analyze) {
  
  # A. Filter Data: Include the specific Gene AND WT rows
  dt_gene <- dt_full %>%
    filter(Drug %in% drugs_of_interest) %>%
    filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control', `Dose Label` != 'Vehicle') %>%
    filter(`Mutated Gene` == gene | `Mutated Gene` == "WT") %>%
    # Create a consistent grouping column where WT is labeled explicitly
    mutate(Group_Label = ifelse(`Mutated Gene` == "WT", "WT", as.character(`Variant Risk Level`)))

  # B. Calculate Descriptive Stats (Mean ± SD)
  summary_stats <- dt_gene %>%
    group_by(Group_Label, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      `norm_FPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_FPD, na.rm=T)*100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_FPD, na.rm=T)*100, 1)),
      `norm_cFPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_cFPD, na.rm=T)*100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_cFPD, na.rm=T)*100, 1)),
      `norm_RR` = paste(round(mean(norm_RR, na.rm=T)*100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_RR, na.rm=T)*100, 1)),
      `norm_PtPA` = paste(round(mean(norm_PtPA, na.rm=T)*100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_PtPA, na.rm=T)*100, 1)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(`Mutated Gene` = gene) # Add Gene Name column

  # C. Calculate P-values (Comparisons vs WT)
  p_values <- dt_gene %>%
    group_by(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
    do({
      # Get WT data for this specific drug/dose
      wt_data <- filter(., Group_Label == "WT")
      
      # Identify other groups (Low Risk, High Risk)
      risk_groups <- unique(.$Group_Label[.$Group_Label != "WT"])
      
      # Run test for each risk group vs WT
      results <- lapply(risk_groups, function(grp) {
        test_data <- filter(., Group_Label == grp)
        
        # Helper to run test if data exists
        calc_test <- function(var) {
          if(nrow(wt_data) > 1 && nrow(test_data) > 1) {
            wilcox.test(test_data[[var]], wt_data[[var]])$p.value
          } else { NA }
        }
        
        tibble(
          Group_Label = grp,
          p_norm_FPD = calc_test("norm_FPD"),
          p_norm_cFPD = calc_test("norm_cFPD"),
          p_norm_RR = calc_test("norm_RR"),
          p_norm_PtPA = calc_test("norm_PtPA")
        )
      })
      
      bind_rows(results)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  # D. Join Stats with P-values
  # This merges the calculated p-values into the specific "Low Risk" or "High Risk" rows
  summary_combined <- summary_stats %>%
    left_join(p_values, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label", "Group_Label")) %>%
    mutate(
      `norm_FPD`  = paste0(`norm_FPD`, format_p(p_norm_FPD)),
      `norm_cFPD` = paste0(`norm_cFPD`, format_p(p_norm_cFPD)),
      `norm_RR`   = paste0(`norm_RR`, format_p(p_norm_RR)),
      `norm_PtPA` = paste0(`norm_PtPA`, format_p(p_norm_PtPA))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Mutated Gene`, `Group_Label`, Drug, `Dose Label`, N, 
                  `norm_FPD`, `norm_cFPD`, `norm_RR`, `norm_PtPA`)
  
  results_list[[gene]] <- summary_combined
}

# --- 3. Combine and Save ---
final_summary_table <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Arrange columns for clarity
final_summary_table <- final_summary_table %>%
  rename(`Variant Risk Level` = Group_Label) %>%
  arrange(`Mutated Gene`, Drug, `Dose Label`, `Variant Risk Level`)

# View(final_summary_table)


###Fisher test


# --- 1. Define Analysis Function ---
# This function takes a specific gene name, filters the data, runs the stats, and returns the table
analyze_gene_fisher <- function(target_gene, full_data) {
  
  message(paste("Processing Fisher Tests for:", target_gene))
  
  # A. Filter Data: Target Gene + WT (Shared Controls)
  fisher_data <- full_data %>%
    filter(Drug %in% c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")) %>%
    filter(`Dose Label` != "Control", `Dose Label` != "Vehicle") %>%
    # Keep rows for the specific gene OR Wild Type
    filter(`Mutated Gene` == target_gene | `Mutated Gene` == "WT") %>%
    # Create Group Label
    mutate(Group_Label = ifelse(`Mutated Gene` == "WT", "WT", as.character(`Variant Risk Level`))) %>%
    filter(Group_Label %in% c("WT", "Low Risk", "High Risk"))
  
  # B. Create Summary Table (Counts per FourScore)
  summary_table <- fisher_data %>%
    group_by(Group_Label, Drug, `Dose Label`, `FourScore`) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(FourScore = factor(FourScore, levels = 0:3)) %>%
    # Complete missing FourScore levels with 0
    group_by(Group_Label, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
    complete(`FourScore`, fill = list(count = 0)) %>%
    # Calculate Totals and Percentages
    mutate(total_count = sum(count)) %>%
    mutate(percent = ifelse(total_count > 0, count / total_count * 100, 0)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # C. Perform Fisher's Exact Tests (Pairwise against WT)
  fisher_results <- summary_table %>%
    select(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
    do({
      curr_drug <- .$Drug
      curr_dose <- .$`Dose Label`
      
      # Data for this drug/dose
      subset_data <- summary_table %>%
        filter(Drug == curr_drug, `Dose Label` == curr_dose)
      
      # Helper: Run Fisher for specific group vs WT
      run_fisher <- function(group_name) {
        test_subset <- subset_data %>% filter(Group_Label %in% c("WT", group_name))
        
        # Need data in both groups
        if(n_distinct(test_subset$Group_Label) < 2) return(NA)
        
        tbl <- xtabs(count ~ Group_Label + FourScore, data = test_subset)
        tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
      }
      
      tibble(
        Drug = curr_drug,
        `Dose Label` = curr_dose,
        p_low = run_fisher("Low Risk"),
        p_high = run_fisher("High Risk")
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # D. Join and Format
  final_table <- summary_table %>%
    left_join(fisher_results, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
    mutate(
      raw_p_value = case_when(
        Group_Label == "Low Risk" ~ p_low,
        Group_Label == "High Risk" ~ p_high,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      p_value_formatted = ifelse(is.na(raw_p_value), "",
                                 ifelse(raw_p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", 
                                        round(raw_p_value, 3)))
    ) %>%
    select(Group_Label, Drug, `Dose Label`, FourScore, count, total_count, percent, p_value_formatted) %>%
    mutate(Gene = target_gene) # Add gene column for clarity
  
  return(final_table)
}

# --- 2. Execute Analysis for KCNQ1 and KCNH2 ---

# Run for KCNQ1
kcnq1_fisher_table <- analyze_gene_fisher("KCNQ1", dt_full)

# Run for KCNH2
kcnh2_fisher_table <- analyze_gene_fisher("KCNH2", dt_full)

# View(kcnh2_fisher_table)
```

# Figure S24 - XGBoost
```{r}
# Re-analysis for Figure 7B using XGBoost
# This script trains an XGBoost model to classify Variant Risk Level.

#Load the data
dt <- combined_output_files

# Set up factor levels for the target variable
dt$`Variant Risk Level` <- factor(dt$`Variant Risk Level`, levels = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))

# Select the same features as in the original Random Forest model
xgb_risk <- dt %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    "T Detection Timestamp [µs]",
    "Dose [pM]",
    "Mean RR Interval [µs]",
    "Mean Peak-to-Peak Amplitude [pV]",
    "Mean Slope [V/s]",
    "RR Interval CV",
    "Drug",
    "Variant Risk Level",
    "FourScore",
    "norm_FPD",
    "norm_RR",
    "norm_PtPA"
    ) %>%
  na.omit() # Remove rows with missing values

# Split the data
set.seed(86) # Use the same seed for reproducibility
data_split <- initial_split(xgb_risk,
                            prop = .7,
                            strata = Drug) # 70/30 split, stratified by Drug

xgb_risk_train <- training(data_split)
xgb_risk_validate <- testing(data_split)

risk_rec <-
  recipe(`Variant Risk Level` ~ ., data = xgb_risk_train) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors())

# XGBoost model with tunable hyperparameters
xgb_spec <-
  boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    min_n = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune()
  ) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

xgb_wflow <-
  workflow() %>%
  add_model(xgb_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(risk_rec)

# Tuning Grid
xgb_grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(
  trees(),
  tree_depth(),
  min_n(),
  loss_reduction(),
  sample_size = sample_prop(),
  finalize(mtry(), xgb_risk_train),
  learn_rate(),
  size = 25 # Number of hyperparameter combinations to try
)

# CV
set.seed(123)
cv_data_tune_risk <- vfold_cv(xgb_risk_train, v = 10, strata = `Variant Risk Level`)

# Hyperparameter tuning
tune_results_risk_xgb <-
  xgb_wflow %>%
  tune_grid(
    resamples = cv_data_tune_risk,
    grid = xgb_grid,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  )

# Selecting the best model and finalizing wf
best_xgb_params <-
  tune_results_risk_xgb %>%
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")

final_xgb_wflow <-
  xgb_wflow %>%
  finalize_workflow(best_xgb_params)

# Fitting to the training dataset
final_xgb_fit <-
  final_xgb_wflow %>%
  fit(data = xgb_risk_train)

saveRDS(final_xgb_fit, file = "models/final_risk_classification_model_xgboost.rds")

# Evaluate the model on the 30% validation set
risk_aug_xgb <-
  augment(final_xgb_fit, xgb_risk_validate)

# Collect performance metrics from CV tuning
best_model_metrics_xgb <-
  collect_metrics(tune_results_risk_xgb) %>%
  inner_join(best_xgb_params, by = names(best_xgb_params))

print("Best Model Performance (from cross-validation):")
print(best_model_metrics_xgb)

# Plot ROC curves
ROC_risk_xgb <-
  risk_aug_xgb %>%
  roc_curve(truth = `Variant Risk Level`, `.pred_High Risk`) %>%
  ggplot(aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity)) +
  geom_abline(lty = 2, col = "gray80", size = 1) +
  geom_path(show.legend = FALSE, alpha = .8, size = 2, col = "#0072B2") + # Using a different color
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "XGBoost: Variant Risk Classification",
    subtitle = "Performance on the 30% validation set"
  ) +
  annotate("text", label = paste("Accuracy: ", round(best_model_metrics_xgb %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(mean), 2)), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -3, hjust = 1.1, size = 8) +
  annotate("text", label = paste("AUC: ", round(best_model_metrics_xgb %>% filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>% pull(mean), 2)), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -1, hjust = 1.1, size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 22),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5))


ggsave("figures/FigureS24_ROC_risk_XGBoost.pdf", ROC_risk_xgb, width = 22, height = 20, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
                            strata = drug) #Be aware that here `drug` is smallcase

lgbm_risk_train <- training(data_split)
lgbm_risk_validate <- testing(data_split)

risk_rec <-
  recipe(`variant_risk_level` ~ ., data = lgbm_risk_train) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors())

# LightGBM model with tunable hyperparameters
lgbm_spec <-
  boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    min_n = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune()
  ) %>%
  set_engine("lightgbm") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

lgbm_wflow <-
  workflow() %>%
  add_model(lgbm_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(risk_rec)

# Tuning Grid
lgbm_grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(
  trees(),
  tree_depth(),
  min_n(),
  loss_reduction(),
  sample_size = sample_prop(),
  finalize(mtry(), lgbm_risk_train),
  learn_rate(),
  size = 20
)
 
# CV
set.seed(123)
cv_data_tune_risk <- vfold_cv(lgbm_risk_train, v = 10, strata = `variant_risk_level`) #Be aware that the `variant_risk_level` here is smallcase.

# Hyperparameter tuning
tune_results_risk_lgbm <-
  lgbm_wflow %>%
  tune_grid(
    resamples = cv_data_tune_risk,
    grid = lgbm_grid,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  )

# Selecting the best model and finalizing wf
best_lgbm_params <-
  tune_results_risk_lgbm %>%
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")

final_lgbm_wflow <-
  lgbm_wflow %>%
  finalize_workflow(best_lgbm_params)

# Fitting to the training dataset
final_lgbm_fit <-
  final_lgbm_wflow %>%
  fit(data = lgbm_risk_train)

saveRDS(final_lgbm_fit, file = "models/final_risk_classification_model_lgbm.rds")

# Evaluate the model on the 30% validation set
risk_aug_lgbm <-
  augment(final_lgbm_fit, lgbm_risk_validate)

# Collect performance metrics from CV tuning
best_model_metrics_lgbm <-
  collect_metrics(tune_results_risk_lgbm) %>%
  inner_join(best_lgbm_params, by = names(best_lgbm_params))

print("Best Model Performance (from cross-validation):")
print(best_model_metrics_lgbm)

# Plot ROC curves
ROC_risk_lgbm <-
  risk_aug_lgbm %>%
  roc_curve(truth = `variant_risk_level`, `.pred_High Risk`) %>%
  ggplot(aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity)) +
  geom_abline(lty = 2, col = "gray80", size = 1) +
  geom_path(show.legend = FALSE, alpha = .8, size = 2, col = "#C2095A") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "LightGBM: Variant Risk Classification",
    subtitle = "Performance on the 30% validation set"
  ) +
  annotate("text", label = paste("Accuracy: ", round(best_model_metrics_lgbm %>% filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(mean), 2)), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -3, hjust = 1.1, size = 8) +
  annotate("text", label = paste("AUC: ", round(best_model_metrics_lgbm %>% filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>% pull(mean), 2)), x = Inf, y = -Inf, vjust = -1, hjust = 1.1, size = 8) +
  #theme_base(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 22),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5))


ggsave("figures/FigureS24_ROC_risk_LightGBM.pdf", ROC_risk_lgbm, width = 22, height = 20, units = "cm")
```

```{r}

t <- dt %>%
  filter(Variant == "KCNH2-p.R366X")

t$`Cell Line` <- factor(t$`Cell Line`,levels = c("HDF26c1", "HDF27c2"))

summary_table <- t %>%
  filter(`Cell Line` %in% c("HDF26c1", "HDF27c2")) %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c( "Dofetilide", "E4031", "HMR1556", "HMR1556 (after E4031)")) %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Control") %>%
  group_by(`Cell Line`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

summary_table <- t %>%
  filter(`Cell Line` %in% c("HDF26c1", "HDF27c2")) %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c( "Dofetilide", "E4031", "HMR1556", "HMR1556 (after E4031)")) %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Control") %>%
  group_by(`Cell Line`, Drug, `Dose Label`, `FourScore`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%  #FourScore counts calculation
  mutate(FourScore = factor(FourScore, levels = 0:3)) %>%
  group_by(`Cell Line`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  complete(`FourScore`, fill = list(count = 0)) %>% #Complete missing FourScore values
  group_by(`Cell Line`, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(percent = ifelse(total_count > 0, count / total_count * 100, 0)) %>% #calculate the percentages
  ungroup()

#Create a contingency table and perform Fisher's Exact tests
fisher_test_results <- summary_table  %>%
  group_by( Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    tbl <- xtabs(count ~ `Cell Line` + FourScore, data = .)
    test_result <- fisher.test(tbl)  # Perform Fisher's Exact Test
    tibble(p_value = test_result$p.value)  # Extract p-value and return as a tibble
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#Join Fisher test results (p-values) to the summary table
summary_table_with_p <- summary_table %>%
  left_join(fisher_test_results, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", round(p_value, 3))  # Format p-values
  )
```

```{r}
# --- 5. Main Execution Loop ---

drugs3 <- c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")

`%+%` <- ggplot2::`%+%`

combined_plots_list <- lapply(drugs3, function(drug) {
  
  # Filter data specific to this drug
  drug_data <- dt_plot_source %>% filter(Drug == drug)
  
  # A. Bar Plots - Filtered specifically by VARIANT NAME
  
  # Plot 1: KCNH2-p.T983I (Teal)
  drug_plot1 <- plot_bar_base %+% filter(drug_data, Variant == "KCNH2-p.T983I") + 
    ggtitle("KCNH2-p.T983I") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, color = Variant_Palette[["KCNH2-p.T983I"]]),
          axis.title.y = element_text(color = Variant_Palette[["KCNH2-p.T983I"]], size = 8))
  
  # Plot 2: KCNH2-p.R823W (Purple)
  drug_plot2 <- plot_bar_base %+% filter(drug_data, Variant == "KCNH2-p.R823W") + 
    ggtitle("KCNH2-p.R823W") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, color = Variant_Palette[["KCNH2-p.R823W"]]),
          axis.title.y = element_text(color = Variant_Palette[["KCNH2-p.R823W"]], size = 8))
  
  # B. Line Plots (Use full drug data containing both variants)
  drug_plot3 <- plot3 %+% drug_data
  drug_plot4 <- plot4 %+% drug_data
  drug_plot5 <- plot5 %+% drug_data
  
  # C. Combine Vertically
  drug_combined_plot <- (drug_plot1 / drug_plot2 / drug_plot3 / drug_plot4 / drug_plot5) + 
    plot_layout() &
    theme(plot.background = element_blank())
  
  # Add Drug Name Title
  drug_combined_plot_with_text <- drug_combined_plot + 
    plot_annotation(title = drug, 
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1)))
  
  return(drug_combined_plot_with_text)
})

# Arrange grid
grid_plot <- plot_grid(plotlist = combined_plots_list, 
                       ncol = length(combined_plots_list), 
                       label_size = 20)

# Save
ggsave("./figures/FigureS23_Validation_lines_dose_resp.pdf", grid_plot, width = 25.7, height = 18, units = "cm")
```

###FigureS25 Stats
```{r}
# --- 1. Filter Data for the specific Cell Lines/Variants ---
# We use dt_validation (or dt_full if unavailable) and filter for the SCVI lines

  dt_stats_source <- dt_validation


dt_stats <- dt_stats_source %>%
  filter(`Cell Line` %in% c("SCVI209c1", "SCVI507c1")) %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")) %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Control') %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != 'Vehicle')

# --- 2. Calculate Mean ± SD Summary ---
summary_stats <- dt_stats %>%
  group_by(Variant, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),  # Count total observations per group
    `norm_FPD`  = paste(round(mean(norm_FPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_FPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_cFPD` = paste(round(mean(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_cFPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_RR`   = paste(round(mean(norm_RR, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_RR, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    `norm_PtPA` = paste(round(mean(norm_PtPA, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " ± ", round(sd(norm_PtPA, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# --- 3. Calculate P-values (Wilcoxon Test) ---
# Comparing the two Variants (T983I vs R823W) at each Drug/Dose
p_values <- dt_stats %>%
  group_by(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    # Check if we have data for both variants to compare
    if(n_distinct(.$Variant) > 1) {
      p_val_norm_FPD  <- wilcox.test(norm_FPD ~ Variant, data = .)$p.value
      p_val_norm_cFPD <- wilcox.test(norm_cFPD ~ Variant, data = .)$p.value
      p_val_norm_RR   <- wilcox.test(norm_RR ~ Variant, data = .)$p.value
      p_val_norm_PtPA <- wilcox.test(norm_PtPA ~ Variant, data = .)$p.value
    } else {
      p_val_norm_FPD <- NA
      p_val_norm_cFPD <- NA
      p_val_norm_RR <- NA
      p_val_norm_PtPA <- NA
    }
    
    # Return results as a data frame
    tibble(
      Drug = first(.$Drug),
      `Dose Label` = first(.$`Dose Label`),
      p_value_norm_FPD = p_val_norm_FPD,
      p_value_norm_cFPD = p_val_norm_cFPD,
      p_value_norm_RR = p_val_norm_RR,
      p_value_norm_PtPA = p_val_norm_PtPA
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 4. Join and Format Output ---
final_summary <- summary_stats %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
    `norm_FPD` = paste0(
      `norm_FPD`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_FPD),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD) <= 0.001, ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_FPD), 2)))), "")
    ),
    
    `norm_cFPD` = paste0(
      `norm_cFPD`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_cFPD),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) <= 0.001, ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_cFPD), 2)))), "")
    ),
    
    `norm_RR` = paste0(
      `norm_RR`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_RR),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR) <= 0.001, ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_RR), 2)))), "")
    ),
    
    `norm_PtPA` = paste0(
      `norm_PtPA`, 
      ifelse(!is.na(p_value_norm_PtPA),
             ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA) <= 0.001, ", p ≤ 0.001", 
                    ifelse(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA) < 0.01, 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA), 3)), 
                           paste(", p =", round(as.numeric(p_value_norm_PtPA), 2)))), "")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variant, Drug, `Dose Label`, N, 
                `norm_FPD`, `norm_cFPD`, `norm_RR`, `norm_PtPA`)

# View and Save
#View(final_summary)


####Fisher Test

# --- 1. Prepare Data Source ---
dt_fisher_source <- dt_validation


# Filter for the specific KCNH2 variants and Drugs
dt_fisher <- dt_fisher_source %>%
  filter(`Cell Line` %in% c("SCVI209c1", "SCVI507c1")) %>%
  filter(Drug %in% c("Dofetilide", "E4031", "Haloperidol")) %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Control") %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Vehicle")

# --- 2. Create Summary Table ---
summary_table <- dt_fisher %>%
  group_by(Variant, Drug, `Dose Label`, `FourScore`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Ensure all FourScore levels (0-3) exist for every group, filling 0 if missing
  mutate(FourScore = factor(FourScore, levels = 0:3)) %>%
  group_by(Variant, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  complete(`FourScore`, fill = list(count = 0)) %>%
  # Calculate Totals and Percentages
  group_by(Variant, Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(percent = ifelse(total_count > 0, count / total_count * 100, 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 3. Perform Fisher's Exact Tests ---
# We compare the distribution of FourScores between the two Variants for each Drug/Dose
fisher_test_results <- summary_table %>%
  group_by(Drug, `Dose Label`) %>%
  do({
    # Create contingency table: Rows = Variant, Cols = FourScore
    tbl <- xtabs(count ~ Variant + FourScore, data = .)
    
    # Run Fisher's Exact Test
    # Note: simulate.p.value=TRUE might be needed if table is large/computational limits hit, 
    # but for typical plate data, standard exact test usually works.
    tryCatch({
      test_result <- fisher.test(tbl)
      tibble(p_value = test_result$p.value)
    }, error = function(e) {
      tibble(p_value = NA) # Handle cases with insufficient data/errors
    })
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 4. Join Results and Format ---
summary_table_with_p <- summary_table %>%
  left_join(fisher_test_results, by = c("Drug", "Dose Label")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Format p-value for readability
    p_value_formatted = ifelse(is.na(p_value), "NA",
                               ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", 
                                      round(p_value, 3)))
  ) %>%
  # Select/Arrange columns for clean output
  select(Drug, `Dose Label`, Variant, FourScore, count, total_count, percent, p_value_formatted) %>%
  arrange(Drug, `Dose Label`, Variant, FourScore)

# Print the table
#View(summary_table_with_p)
```

```{r}
co <- read_csv("./data/Carry_over_Dataset.csv")

co <- co %>%
  select(-Timepoint.y) %>%
  rename(Timepoint = Timepoint.x)

co <- co %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(
      Timepoint,
      `1`  = "3 min",
      `10` = "10 min"
    )
  )
##Levels setup
co$Timepoint <- factor(co$Timepoint, levels = c("3 min", "10 min"))

co$`Cell Line` <- factor(co$`Cell Line`,
  levels = c(
    "WTC-11",
    "SCVI498c1"))

co$`Variant` <- factor(co$Variant,
  levels = c(
    "WT",
    "KCNH2-p.A561V"))

co$`Dose Label` <- factor(co$`Dose Label`, levels = c("Control",  "1 pM", "30 nM", "1 µM"))
co$Disease <- factor(co$Disease, levels = c("Healthy",  "LQT2"))
co$FourScore <- factor(co$FourScore, levels = c(3, 2, 1, 0))
co$Drug <- factor(co$Drug, levels = c("No drop", "RBK", "DMSO", "ETOH", "NIFE", "Dofetilide"))

co <- co %>%
  mutate(`Plot_Label` = if_else(`Dose Label` != "Control",
                              Timepoint, `Dose Label`))

co <- co %>%
  group_by(Plate, `Well Label`, `Dose Label`) %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` != "Control" | row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

co$`Plot_Label` <- factor(co$`Plot_Label`, levels = c("Control", "3 min", "10 min"))


Palette6 <- c("black", "darkgrey", "grey", "#968E85", "#E5446D", "#6075B2") 

p <- 
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Helvetica"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    aspect.ratio = 1/1,

    plot.background = element_rect(color = "white"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
    )

co <- co %>%
  mutate(PairID = interaction(Plate, `Well Label`, drop = TRUE))

  norm_FPD = "Normalized FPD",
  norm_RR = "Normalized RR",
  norm_PtPA = "Normalized PtPA"
)



 for (y_var in names(y_vars)) {

  y_label <- y_vars[[y_var]]

    ggplot(aes(x = `Plot_Label`, y = .data[[y_var]], group = PairID, colour = Drug, fill = Drug)) +

    stat_summary(aes(group = Drug), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.5) +

    facet_grid(. ~ Variant) +

      y = y_label,

    ) +

    units = "cm"
  )
```
