###FigureS27 Carry-over stats
```{r}
drug_comparisons <- list(
  c("DMSO", "Dofetilide"),
  c("ETOH", "NIFE")
)
timepoints <- c("3 min", "10 min")
y_vars <- c("norm_FPD", "norm_RR", "norm_PtPA")

wilcox_table <- bind_rows(lapply(y_vars, function(y_var) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    
    bind_rows(lapply(drug_comparisons, function(drugs) {
      
      # 1. Filter and Rename data
      # We create a generic 'value' column here based on the current y_var loop
      subset_data <- co %>%
        filter(`Plot_Label` == tp, Drug %in% drugs) %>%
        select(Variant, Drug, value = .data[[y_var]]) %>%
        drop_na(value)
      
      # 2. Run Test
      subset_data %>%
        group_by(Variant) %>%
        summarise(
          endpoint   = y_var,
          timepoint  = tp,
          comparison = paste(drugs[1], "-", drugs[2]),
          p.value    = {
            # Extract vectors for the two specific drugs
            group1 <- value[Drug == drugs[1]]
            group2 <- value[Drug == drugs[2]]
            
            # Error handling: Only run test if both groups have data
            if(length(group1) > 0 && length(group2) > 0) {
              wilcox.test(group1, group2, paired = FALSE, exact = FALSE)$p.value
            } else {
              NA_real_ # Return NA if data is missing
            }
          },
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    }))
  }))
})) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE             ~ ""
    )
  )

```

###FigureS28 Inner-outer wells
```{r}
# Test to verify whether outer wells in the MEA have different EP characteristics at baseline compared to inner wells

# Setting custom theme

LS_theme <- 
  theme_base(base_size = 10)+ 
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
        axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        axis.title=element_text(size=26),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))

theme_set(LS_theme)

        
# Loading data
df <- dt_full

# Define outer wells
outer_wells <- c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6",
                   "B1", "B6",
                   "C1", "C6",
                   "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "D5", "D6")

# Define inner wells
inner_wells <- c("B2", "B3", "B4", "B5",
                   "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5")

df_control <- df %>%
  filter(`Dose Label` == "Control") %>%
  mutate(
    Inner_Outer = case_when(
      `Well Label` %in% outer_wells ~ "Outer Wells",
      `Well Label` %in% inner_wells ~ "Inner Wells",
      TRUE ~ "Error"
    )
  )

# group_counts <- df_control %>%
#   group_by(`Well Label`) %>%
#   summarise(
#     N = n()
#   )
# 
# View(group_counts)

FPD <- df_control %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Inner_Outer, y = FPD, fill = Inner_Outer)) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar",  colour = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar",  colour = "black", width = 0.2) +
  geom_quasirandom(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +  # points follow violin shape
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Inner Wells", "Outer Wells")),
                     method = "t.test", label = "p.format", size = 10)+
  labs(y = "FPD (ms)",
       x = "")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")


RR <- df_control %>%

  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar",  colour = "black", width = 0.2) +
  geom_quasirandom(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +  # points follow violin shape
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Inner Wells", "Outer Wells")),
                     method = "t.test", label = "p.format", size = 10)+
  labs(y = "RR (s)",
       x = "")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  # stat_summary(fun = length, geom = "text", aes(label = ..y..),
  #              vjust = 0.5, colour = "black", size = 4)


cFPD <- df_control %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Inner_Outer, y = cFPD, fill = Inner_Outer)) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", colour = "black") +

  geom_quasirandom(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +  # points follow violin shape
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Inner Wells", "Outer Wells")),
                     method = "t.test", label = "p.format", size = 10)+
  labs(y = "cFPD (ms)",

# cFPD_difference <- df_control %>%

inner_outer_grid <- plot_grid(FPD, RR, cFPD, ncol = 3)

caption <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label("Outer wells: A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B6, C1, C6, D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6\nInner wells: B2, B3, B4, B5, C2, C3, C4, C5.",
             x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 16)

inner_outer_plot <- plot_grid(

ggsave("./figures/FigureS28_inner_outer_plot.pdf", inner_outer_plot, width = 18, height = 11)
```

###PRS Comparison
```{r}



# --- 1. Create Data Frame ---
prs_data <- data.frame(
  Cell_Line = c("WTC-11", "S34Ec16"),
  QT_PRS = c(0.00421053, 0.0310526)
)

# Force Order: WTC-11 First, then S34Ec16
prs_data$Cell_Line <- factor(prs_data$Cell_Line, levels = c("WTC-11", "S34Ec16"))

# --- 2. Define Theme & Colors ---
bar_colors <- c("WTC-11" = "#009E73",  
                "S34Ec16" = "#F0E442") 

my_theme <- theme(
  text = element_text(size = 14, family = "Helvetica"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
  axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
  legend.position = "none", 
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
)

# --- 3. Create Plot ---
p <- ggplot(prs_data, aes(x = Cell_Line, y = QT_PRS, fill = Cell_Line)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bar_colors) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "QT Polygenic Risk Score (PRS)",
    x = "Cell Line",
    y = "QT-PRS"
  ) +
  
  # Add value labels
  geom_text(aes(label = round(QT_PRS, 4)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  
  # Expand Y axis
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  
  # Apply Theme
  my_theme

# --- 4. Save and View ---
print(p)

ggsave("./figures/QT_PRS_Comparison_WT.pdf", p, width = 15, height = 17, units = "cm")
```
